name: Lumen
description: Basic SD Hyper model and 'ip-adapter' style regional prompting that handles image prompts.

variables.name: Adherence
variables.description: How much to follow model geometry via ControlNet depth.

variables.name: Mask Softness
variables.description: How much to soften material prompt masks—softer masks apply to wider areas; harder ones are more constrained.

provenance.attribution: Created by SG_161222 - RealVisXL V5.0 series by SG_161222, originally published September 2, 2024.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: RealVisXL V5.0 is an SDXL Lightning checkpoint merge by SG_161222 combining multiple models such as DreamShaper XL, Juggernaut XL, Noosphere, and HelloWorld XL to achieve high photorealism across SFW and NSFW content.

provenance.attribution: Developed by Stability AI — Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) Refiner 1.0.
provenance.data_provenance_notes: Official SDXL 1.0 Refiner checkpoint by Stability AI, designed for the final denoising steps in the SDXL two-stage pipeline. The public model card does not enumerate specific training dataset sources; see the SDXL technical report for details.

provenance.attribution: Developed by Stability AI - Control-LoRA Depth (rank 128).
provenance.license: Stability AI Control-LoRA Community License Agreement
provenance.data_provenance_notes: Stability AI Control-LoRA depth (rank 128): low-rank finetuning of ControlNet for depth-guided generation. Trained on MiDaS dpt_beit_large_512 depth maps and further fine-tuned using ClipDrop's Portrait Depth Estimation outputs.

provenance.attribution: Created by Tencent AI Lab (tencent-ailab) - IP-Adapter (IP-Adapter Plus for SDXL, ViT-H variant).
provenance.data_provenance_notes: IP-Adapter Plus weights for SDXL that condition generation on patch-level image embeddings from an OpenCLIP ViT-H image encoder via a lightweight adapter (image-prompt conditioning for a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model).

provenance.attribution: Published by LAION; OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 trained by Romain Beaumont (training run credited to Stability AI compute).
provenance.data_provenance_notes: OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 trained on the 2B-sample English subset of LAION-5B (LAION-2B). Dataset is uncurated; LAION advises caution and research-oriented use.

inputs.Scene: objects on a matte white surface against an empty, neutral white background.
inputs.Style: hyperdetailed photography, product photography, professional photography, canon 5d mark iiji photo, 4k Unity, 8k, Zbrush, super-detailed, beautifully lit, octane rendering
